title: Distance and Midpoint
summary: The Cartesian plane, quadrants, and the distance and midpoint formulas.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates

objectives: I can plot points in all four quadrants.
I can find the distance between two points.
I can find the midpoint of a segment.
misconceptions: Distance = difference in x + difference in y.
The midpoint is found by subtracting.
